briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent rollout escalates AGI race as DialectForge secures protocol patents

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid compute shortages. US-China tensions drive new export controls on advanced chips. Funding surges in safety tooling and multi-agent infrastructure.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 with 2M context. xAI trains Colossus-2 cluster for Grok-3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, CAN bus, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1M units shipped. Microsoft announces $50B data center expansion in Texas. TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI ASICs. Saudi sovereign fund commits $20B to regional AI hyperscale.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier multi-agent deployments by 2028?
